summary: Tests-only red-phase run for issue #5 (replace hand-written API layer with a generated OpenAPI Swift client). The permanent tests and the PR-description evidence docs are committed; every implementation-dependent acceptance criterion is intentionally unsatisfied at this head, so its criterion status is 'failed' with the red test as the named, inspectable evidence. Infrastructure note: this container has NO Swift toolchain (no swift/xcrun on PATH), so swift test could not be executed here at all; the red state is provable by inspection (the vendored document and generated module the tests depend on do not exist in the tree) and the assertion logic was validated against the reconstructed upstream spec via a Python mirror (all checks passed). Implementation lands in the follow-up run gated on paid-tests-approved.
